package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_lazy_loading_eager_metric_label_cardinality_build: Layer: Lazy loading. Flag eager construction of high-cardinality metric labels before the metric is emitted.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var metricLabels []string

func scenario556Positive(hosts []string, endpoints []string) {
	// All host×endpoint label combinations are pre-built eagerly.
	// For 1000 hosts × 500 endpoints = 500,000 labels, this is
	// wasteful when only a small subset will ever be observed.
	for _, host := range hosts {
		for _, ep := range endpoints {
			label := fmt.Sprintf("host=%s,endpoint=%s,method=GET", host, ep)
			metricLabels = append(metricLabels, label)
		}
	}
}
